Jordan's information minister, Mohammad Mamani,

Mamani said Jordan regretted the deaths

Jordan's public security director said Monday
that the gunmen at the church acted alone.
Syria says Jordan did not coordinate the attacks with it.
It closed its border crossing with the kingdom.
Jan Araf, NPR News, Amman.

NPR's Ritu Chatterjee has more.
The report sums up the findings of a survey

in 21 American states.
More than a quarter of the respondents

The survey also found a link between certain kinds of AI use

Students who used AI for schoolwork or homework
